text:
Connect outside events and services without sharing their credentials. Receive authenticated events or send a body to a configured destination. Start with routes to see available names; post sends once and returns the response.
[destructive] post <route> <body...>: Send one body to a configured outbound route, once. The reply contains the HTTP status and response text.
  route (string): Configured outbound route name; a caller cannot supply a URL
  body (string): UTF-8 body, unchanged; at most 262144 bytes and the route cap
routes: Find configured route names and whether they receive or send events. Credentials and URLs are not shown.

Examples
agent-bus call '#webhook@parf.us' routes
